citation.title: Overbite depth indicator with particular reference to anterior open-bite

curation.notes: Compared 2026-10-08 (norms:compare exit 1). Every value re-read from the page image of Table I, p. 592 (PDF p. 7): rows 1, 3, 5, 6, 7, 9, 12, 13, 15 (max / mean / min / SD) all match both extractors. Differences settled: (1) #22 FH-MP definitionMatch a='close' b='same' -> 'same': Kim's mandibular plane is the lower-border tangent (p. 589 item 3; merge notes), the catalogue's MPt. (2) #26 SN-MxP only in b -> kept: Table I row 6 'NS to palatal plane' 18.0 / 8.0 / -1.0 / 3.45 read from the image; 'close' for the sign (b's note). (3) source wording on all rows (prose). Agreed 'close' rows confirmed from p. 590 (PDF p. 5): MMPA (tangent vs Go-Me), gonial (tangent lines, item 9), overbite (Kim's occlusal plane, items 8 and 15). Sample p. 589: 119 Caucasian children aged 7 to 14 (56 boys, 63 girls), no difference by age group or sex (Table I footnote) -> pooled, ageBand [7,14]. Selection class-I (normal occlusion; a had 'unknown'). Scale not-stated. Not entered (not in the catalogue): rows 2 NS to facial plane, 4 NS to mandibular plane (tangent), 8 occlusomandibular plane, 10 faciomandibular plane, 11 AB to mandibular plane, 14 incisal length from the upper lip. Fix round 1 (2026-10-08, review): #22 note names the Fig. 1 legend's 'FH to GoGn' label (p. 589, checked on the page image) against item 3's tangent definition.

caveats: Sample (p. 589): 119 persons of Caucasian ethnic origin with normal occlusion, aged 7 to 14 years (mean 10 years 8 months), 56 boys and 63 girls; Table I footnote: no significant difference between the age groups (7-10, 11-14) or the sexes, so one pooled row per measurement.

Not in the catalogue, not entered: Table I rows 2 (NS to facial plane), 4 (NS to mandibular plane, tangent), 8 (occlusomandibular plane, Kim's own occlusal plane), 10 (faciomandibular plane), 11 (AB to mandibular plane) and 14 (incisal length from the upper lip, mm).
Kim's combination factor and extraction index (#16, #17) are not in this paper; they are website values (Task 8).
Film scale and head position are not stated; the overbite (mm) row is used as printed (assumed true size, owner ruling M-2).

entries.source: Table I, p. 592, row 1 'FH to facial plane'
Table I, p. 592, row 3 'FH to mandibular plane'
entries.note: Kim's mandibular plane: menton to the most inferior-posterior border of the mandibular body (p. 589, item 3), a lower-border tangent. Kim's Fig. 1 legend (p. 589) labels it 'FH to GoGn', but item 3 defines the lower-border tangent.

entries.source: Table I, p. 592, row 5 'FH to palatal plane'
entries.note: Sign as the catalogue (p. 590, item 5): upward and forward negative, downward and forward positive.

entries.source: Table I, p. 592, row 6 'NS to palatal plane'
entries.definitionNote: Same lines (S-N and ANS-PNS), but Kim reads the angle with a sign (his minimum is -1.0; the sign rule for this row is not stated); the catalogue's SN-MxP is the unsigned angle between the lines, so a case Kim would read -1 reads +1 in the app.
Kim's mandibular plane is the lower-border tangent through menton (p. 589, item 3); the catalogue's MMPA uses Go-Me.

Kim's gonial angle is between two tangent lines, the mandibular plane and a line from articulare to the posterior-inferior border of the ramus (p. 590, item 9); the catalogue's is the three-point angle Ar-Go-Me.

entries.source: Table I, p. 592, row 12 'AB to MP plus FH to PP' (text p. 591)
entries.note: A-B plane to mandibular plane (tangent) plus FH to palatal plane if positive, minus if negative (p. 590, item 12).

entries.source: Table I, p. 592, row 15 'Incisal overbite depth (mm.)'
entries.note: Text p. 592: 88.3% of the normal sample fell within 0.5 to 4.0 mm, which Kim designates the normal range. Kim measured the overlap at right angles to his occlusal plane, from the bisection of the incisal overlap to the mesial cusp of the upper first molar (p. 590, items 8 and 15); this app measures at right angles to the line from the middle of the first-molar overlap to the middle of the incisor overlap (since 16 Oct 2026), nearly the same line. Open bite is negative in both. Marked 'same' by owner ruling KIM-OB-1 (16 Oct 2026): Kim's line runs, like the app's, from the incisor overlap to the first molars.
